preconditions.expression: isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 and N <= 20000
preconditions.description: N is an integer between 1 and 20000 inclusive.
arr is a list of length N.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and 1 <= len(s) <= 10 for s in arr)
preconditions.description: Each string in arr is between 1 and 10 characters long.

postconditions.description: The return value is a boolean.

postconditions.expression: return_value == any(arr[i] + arr[j] == arr[i] + arr[j][::-1] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j)
postconditions.description: The return value is true if there exists a pair of strings arr[i] and arr[j] such that their concatenation is a palindrome.
